scope: Manual browser smoke verification of the local built application, not exhaustive end-to-end coverage or clinical validation.
target: Local Python application on loopback port 8010
verified_scenarios: BRFSS overview shows test n=85748, AP=0.321, ROC-AUC=0.839, Recall=50.7%, Precision=31.0% with observed counts.
Threshold-cost lab loads all 36 saved validation points; default FP=1/FN=5 gives working loss=306.7 and grid minimum=302.5 per 1000.
Infeasible Recall/positive-fraction constraints show an explicit no-feasible-points state, with no proposed replacement threshold.
Feasible-only checkbox removes all data rows when constraints cannot be met; reset restores controls, 36 points and clears the checkbox.
At 390x844 the mobile menu opens and navigation closes it; cost lab and model comparison do not cause horizontal document overflow.
Russian and Kazakh language switches update the visible cost lab controls, explanations and table headings.
All 13 metric columns are available; selecting Logistic Regression and LightGBM opens a paired comparison with 13 differences.
UCI diagnostics load averaged OOF n=303 and show its evaluation distinction; ranking and missingness panels load, empty strata remain undefined rather than zero.
The development study shows 36000 train observations, 4 configurations, 3 shared folds, AP=0.31715 vs 0.31629 and only 1/3 positive fold differences.
3D atlas renders WebGL geometry; 75% narrowing gives 25.0% remaining diameter and rounded 6.3% area; paired vessels and fullscreen work.
Switching the atlas from 3D to 2D preserves 75% narrowing and the selected slice; exiting fullscreen works.
UCI synthetic demo fills 13 fields, calculates 16.2% and loads its feature explanation.
Changing the dataset clears the previous prediction; BRFSS synthetic demo calculates 2.7%; clear restores 0/11 fields and disables calculation.
Model passport displays release 3.3.0 and the then-saved 155 Python / 97 Worker results with an explicit historical browser-not-verified status before this audit was recorded.

console.scope: Captured error/warning logs during the resumed browser smoke session

limitations: A browser download event interrupted the automation session. File delivery via browser CSV/PNG/PDF buttons is not claimed as verified; CSV and PDF content/routes were checked separately through API tests and Docker smoke checks.
Mobile verification uses an emulated viewport, not a physical device. Only one browser engine was exercised.
Batch upload and new training launch were not executed through the browser; their page entry points were checked, with server-side behavior covered separately where reported.
Not every parameter combination, sub-tab, accessibility criterion or external literature link was manually exercised.
The public Sites deployment was not updated or tested as this release.
